reconstructed.title: GALOA — SUNS build vs current build, full 2003–2026 window
reconstructed.dataset: Two full-history runs of the same USDJPY M5 system survive: one under the earlier working name "SUNS", one as the current GALOA build on tick-data-suite variable spread. Same market, near-identical window.

reconstructed.title: GALOA — recent-window run (2024–2026)
reconstructed.dataset: A short recent-window run of the SUNS build exists alongside its full-history run. Different windows, so figures are not directly comparable; the record shows the recent window was tested separately.

reconstructed.title: GRANDSLAM — 2022-start vs 2024-start dataset window
reconstructed.dataset: Two runs of the same BTCUSD M5 system over different start dates. The 2022-start window includes the 2022 crypto drawdown regime and reports 60.76% equity drawdown; the 2024-start window reports 21.56%. Same system, different market regimes covered.

reconstructed.title: JOKER — MT4 build vs MT5 rebuild
reconstructed.dataset: An MT4 GOLD run (2003–2026, balance-basis DD 68.16%) and an MT5 XAUUSD rebuild (2016–2026, equity-basis DD 2.00%) both survive. Different platform, period AND drawdown basis, so the figures must not be read as a controlled comparison — but the migration itself is documented fact.

reconstructed.title: NEXUS — two builds on the identical dataset
reconstructed.dataset: Two runs over the identical window (2018.01.01–2026.03.28, BTCUSD M5) with the identical trade count (19,968) but different profit factor (1.52 vs 1.54) and equity drawdown (2.60% vs 5.56%) — a genuine A/B of two builds on the same data. Which build came first is not recorded.

reconstructed.title: GODSPEED — cross-market run on GOLD
reconstructed.dataset: Alongside the GBPJPY release run, the folder holds a GOLD 2006–2026 run. The record shows the logic was tried on a second market; whether that variant relates to the released SENA/RINA gold systems is not documented.

splits.title: COSMOS — 70/30 split stability of the monthly profile
splits.hypothesis: The monthly return profile of the first 70% of the backtest (positive-month share, mean monthly return) persists in the final 30%.
splits.changeSummary: No change to the system. Deterministic analysis over the extracted monthly series; decision rule fixed before computation.
splits.dataset: Extracted monthly returns, chronological 70/30 split at month 69 of 99.
splits.reason: Late window kept a positive mean month (0.22%) and its positive-month share (100%) stayed within 10pp of the early window (100%).
splits.notes: Not out-of-sample validation: the optimisation window of this system is undocumented, so the late 30% may have been seen during tuning. This is a stability check on the recorded equity path.
